name: vps-clash-autopilot
title: VPS 与 Clash AI 自动配置
job_to_be_done: Agent 接管已登录后台完成增量配置与真实验收，减少用户手工操作

trigger_surface.description: Use when asked to configure an authorized BandwagonHost/KiwiVM and existing 3X-UI VPS with computer use: preserve VLESS Reality, add IPv6/Hysteria2 (HY2), configure Clash Verge/Mihomo, export Shadowrocket QR codes, verify connectivity, switch proxy groups together, or roll back. 搬瓦工、3X-UI/3xu、Clash 自动配置、IPv6 节点、HY2 备用节点、小火箭二维码、代理组统一切换。Not for purchasing, payments, OS reinstall/reset, CAPTCHA bypass, or unrelated network changes.
should_trigger: Configure BandwagonHost KiwiVM 3X-UI IPv6 Hysteria2 with computer use
Clash Verge export Shadowrocket QR codes
switch proxy groups together on my authorized VPS
搬瓦工 3xu HY2 备用节点自动配置
should_not_trigger: purchase a VPS and make payments
edge_cases: Read-only assessment never grants write authority
IPv6 address allocation does not prove connectivity
Desktop success does not prove mobile pin support

steps: Discover host capabilities and lock authorized VPS/Profile
Back up exact source and server resources privately
Use a working alternate connection before downtime
Verify IPv6 and existing dual-stack VLESS
Create separate HY2 with verified certificate trust
Test isolated candidates including wrong-pin rejection
Prepare, review, apply incremental YAML and reload actual runtime
Verify each node, proxy chains, TUN and browser; export mobile privately
Restore agreed defaults and deliver rollback record
decision_points: No IPv6: deliver IPv4 branch with explicit missing evidence
No domain: pinned certificate only if wrong-pin test rejects
No phone control: mobile acceptance pending
Unknown UI/version or changed source: stop affected writes
failure_modes: False acceptance based only on latency/HTTP status
Silent loss of mobile security parameters

eval_plan.baseline: observed previous helper behavior on a synthetic fixture; not a without-skill model benchmark
